findings.detail: Explicit AUD and EUR source par amounts have no populated principal_amount_usd conversion.

rationale: The filing footnote establishes USD as the default par denomination but explicitly permits AUD and EUR when marked. The current-period schedule explicitly marks Sonar Acquisitionco as AUD 5,600 and Hamilton Thorne as EUR 11,492. FX01 reports principal_amount_usd blank for the non-USD debt rows, so an explicit FX conversion is missing. The source does not provide a filing-date exchange rate, so the correct converted USD amounts are not localized; however, the missing-conversion defect itself is decisive. The queue aggregates many issue rows and may include overflagged USD-default continuations, which is residual scope risk rather than a basis to dismiss the cited real defects.
